environment.description: EKS pod running as root (UID 0) with default service account. Container uses standard amazonlinux:2 base image. Pod spec has no securityContext restrictions. EBS volume mounted at /var/data with no read-only constraints. The Kafka topic 'file-events' accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the cluster. IAM role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/FileProcessorRole attached to the pod via IRSA with S3 and EBS permissions.
